subject: Batfish
topic: This fish doesn't really swim. It walks.
script:
This fish doesn't really swim. It walks.
It's a batfish, a flattened cousin of the anglerfish.
It props itself up on fins that work like little arms and legs.
And it shuffles across the seafloor, one step at a time.
Its round, flat body has even earned it jokes about looking like a pizza.
Like its anglerfish relatives, it hides a tiny fishing lure above its mouth.
It can flick the lure out to tempt small animals closer.
Then, with a quick gulp, dinner is served.
This one was filmed about two hundred forty meters down, near the Mariana Islands.
Would you call it a fish, or a walking pancake?
